steps.step: two synthetic Businesses; A approved-shaped: a login with no PIN yet, and an activation link
before activation the Business cannot sign in
the activation link validates and names the Business
the owner sets the PIN through it
the link cannot be used again
a wrong PIN and an unknown @ get the same refusal
the right PIN opens a session: ~15-minute access, ~30-day sign-in
home: the Business's own profile, verified
its wallet
balance: a real 0 Kz, not an error
history: an empty list
the refresh token is exchanged for a new pair
the renewed access token works
the retired claim route sets nothing, even for a signed-in Business
the old refresh token presented again is refused
…and the reuse ended the whole sign-in: the new pair is dead too
sign-out ends the session: its refresh token no longer renews
sign-out with a token that means nothing still answers 204 (nothing to learn)
A's token reads nothing of B: profile, wallet, balance
a suspended Business cannot renew its session
the database records why each session ended
refresh tokens are stored only as hashes
